slides.heading: Reception — Spring 1, Week 2
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "zz" (/z/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="buzz" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="buzz"><image href="data:image/png;base64, " x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: When Zinnia the bee gets excited she buzzes extra loud, zzzz, wings a blur.

character.name: Zinnia
character.blurb: Zinnia doubles her buzz when she's excited — one zigzag wing-beat just isn't enough.

slides.pronunciation_note: Still just one buzzing 'zzzz' sound even though it's written with two letters — hold it, don't say it twice.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'z' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Shake both hands fast by your ears like buzzing wings and hold zzzz.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="buzz" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="buzz"><image href="data:image/png;base64, " x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: A tiny two-letter word where 'e' says 'ee' — link hands with a friend and say 'we' together to make it stick.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "qu" (/kw/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="quack" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="quack"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Quinn the quail quivers her tail feathers, kw-kw, whenever she's asking a question.

character.name: Quinn
character.blurb: Quinn is a curious little bird who quivers her tail whenever something puzzles her.

slides.pronunciation_note: Two sounds squashed together, 'k' then 'w' — say them fast as one: kw. These two letters are never split up.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'q': start at the top right of a small round shape, curve round to the left and back up, then pull straight down below the line and finish there. Then write 'u' close beside it. 'q' is always followed by 'u'.
slides.action: Tilt your head to one side like you're puzzled and give a little shiver, saying kw-kw.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="quack" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="quack"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ch" (/tʃ/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="chair" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="chair"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Chip the squirrel chomps his acorn in one quick bite, ch-ch, cheeks full.

character.name: Chip
character.blurb: Chip isn't a squirrel himself but the acorn he guards — he squeaks a sharp ch-ch whenever anyone tries to chomp him.

slides.pronunciation_note: One quick sound made together, 'ch' — like a small sneeze, don't say 'c' and 'h' apart.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'c', then 'h', close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Snap your fingers once close to your mouth like a quick chomp, saying ch-ch.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="chair" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="chair"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Extra practice blending and segmenting everything taught this week — no new content today.

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.
